hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: If x <= y, we can only increment by 1 at each step, taking y - x operations.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: When x > y, we can decrement by 1, increment by 1, divide by 5 if divisible, or divide by 11 if divisible.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Use BFS queue starting at (x, 0) with a visited set bounded between 1 and x + 11 to find the shortest path to y.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unbounded search or greedy division without exploration can miss optimal adjustments.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(x) queue and visited set memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model operations as an unweighted state-graph and solve with BFS.
